title: Commanders activate Tress Way, Dorance Armstrong, Trey Amos

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Commanders activate Tress Way, Dorance Armstrong, Trey Amos
sources.description: Wide receiver Stefon Diggs will be on the field with the Commanders for the first time in training camp after officially signing with the team on Friday and Washington will be welcoming three others back to active duty as well.
